items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, Leonidow was a very big impresario. Didn't he handle Chaliapin and people like that, opera singers. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. This was his first venture into -- with jazz, see.

ctx.x: They kept coming, and people just kept coming. And we kept setting back dates. Setting back other dates. As long as they could pull us out of Berlin. Because Berlin was the major city and at the same time they were putting the propaganda out, how great we were.
